name: Cassmund Furrow
features: BLOOD HUNTER 2 (Alternate, laserllama v2.2; Banked of Okton's order). Rite Die d4, Rite save DC 12
Hunter's Bane: Occult Lore (Arcana); Sinister Insight (bonus action, CON check, DC 8+CR)
Blood Rites known: Siphoning, Binding (each free once per rest, then Vital Sacrifice)
Crimson Offering (bonus action + Vital Sacrifice; 1 hour; Rite Die extra damage)
Vital Sacrifice: lose current and max HP equal to the Rite Die until a long rest
Order of the Pale Moon at level 3 (Okton gives only this order). Latent beast: Hawk.
Race (Half-Orc): Darkvision 60 ft, Relentless Endurance (drop to 1 HP instead of 0, once per long rest), Savage Attacks (extra weapon die on a crit)
Banked: advantage on saves against losing control of the burn; can bleed the heat off with a Vital Sacrifice (drops one stage for 24 hours)
notes: Age 24, male. Pre-conversion level 2. Rank: Raw (converted day 3). Tall, earnest, wide-eyed; a farmer's hands. Farm boy turned Watch recruit. Quick to laugh, quick to be afraid of himself.
